english.note: Use this colloquial choice when someone is uneasy because they are worried about something.

exampleSentences.english: I kept looking at my phone uneasily, waiting for my mum to reply.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我心掛掛咁望住個電話，等阿媽覆我。
